desc: Putting on a Relic (MaskBeat, scripts/ui/mask_beat.gd): build-up, the Relic rising to the face, a cut to black and silence, the fallen Hunter on grey panels of their painted art (three memories: their past, their fall, the legend, the last held with a whisper; a Hunter without them shows their face, then their pose), the snap back with an impact and a ripple of light, a pose, the name and title, and a sting. Times in seconds. 'full' is the first Mask (and every first time); 'short' is a later Mask on the farm. About 2.3x its first cut, the panels 4-6 s in all (owner 11-11: too fast to read; 'like 5 s, not 1 s'; owner 11-17: they went by in 1-2 s because the farm's first Relic ran the short cut and a click cut it short: now the first Mask anywhere is the full cut and clicks never skip the memories until one has been seen). MaskBeat holds the whisper and the name for at least its reading time (3 s, or 0.06 s per character), stretching memory_s and reveal_s if a line needs it. A click moves on a beat; after the first one, holding skips.
times_doc: build_s: the world quiets, the camera eases in, swell and heartbeat. rise_s: the Relic lifts to the face in slow motion while a ghostly porcelain face flickers over yours. black_s: the hard silence after contact. memory_s: one entry per memory frame of the fallen Hunter (their painted memories, or their face and then their splash: the same total shared out when the count differs), the last held with the whisper. reveal_s: the snap back to the end (pose, name and title, sting). push_in: how far the camera eases in (0..1 of the way to the face).

whispers.gunslinger: Another job. Another mark on the tally.
whispers.juggernaut: The blade is hungry. Feed it, or it feeds on you.
whispers.archer: Every mask I sewed, I will cut loose.
whispers.bulwark: Hold on. The shore is close.
whispers.mage: One day I give the storm back.
whispers.rimewright: Skate. Don't look down at the ice.
whispers.ostra: Go on, laugh. I'll keep it.
whispers.thief: I only meant to take a look.
whispers.gil: Ooh, what does this one do?

sting_doc: Each Hunter's sting is the same rising motif in their own key (semitones from A3).
